description_en:
Retrieves or creates an invitation code for desktop device enrollment.
Query mode: Pass only terminalGroupId to return the current invitation code and its expiration status in read-only mode.
Creation mode: Pass terminalGroupId along with an expiration duration (expireDays or expireMinutes) to generate a new code that overwrites the existing invitation code
description_zh:
获取桌面端纳管邀请码。
查询模式：仅传 terminalGroupId，只读返回当前邀请码及过期状态。
创建模式：必须传terminalGroupId+过期时长——传 expireDays或expireMinutes，会生成新码并覆盖原邀请码
name: GetOrCreateInvitationCode

parameters.help_en: The validity period in days, calculated from the current time. Set to -1 for permanent validity
parameters.help_zh: 有效天数,距离当前的天数,-1代表长期有效
parameters.name: expire_days

parameters.help_en:
The validity period type. Valid values:
1: The response returns the expiration in days. This is the default value if Type is not specified.
2: The response returns the expiration in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 有效期类型：不填写或Type=1，对应响应过期天数。Type=2，对应响应过期分钟
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The validity period in minutes, calculated from the current time. Set to -1 for permanent validity
parameters.help_zh: 有效分钟,距离当前的分钟数,-1代表长期有效
parameters.name: expire_minutes

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned when the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的数据

AuthCode.description_en: The authentication code for device enrollment

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the compute group

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the invitation code has expired

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
